mentions.name: PushScroll
mentions.description: This app turns exercise into screen time: every pushup performed earns one minute of scrolling allowed on the phone, gating social media use behind physical activity. It has grown to roughly $30k in monthly revenue, driven heavily by Instagram marketing with 10M views, and some users have completed over 8,000 pushups. The roadmap focuses on improving the product experience.
